prompt:
A high-detail PARALLAX BACKGROUND SEGMENT for a 2D pixel art side-scrolling game.

COMPOSITION: FARTHEST distance layer, segment A. A DENSE cluster of tall skyscrapers occupying the LEFT half, then the skyline DROPS AWAY to low flat rooftops across the RIGHT half leaving wide OPEN EMPTY SKY. Four depth bands, each further band hazier and lighter. Tiny irregular window lights in magenta, amber, cyan and green. Antenna masts, red aircraft warning beacons, a tall needle spire, thin suspended cables between towers, two or three tiny aircraft as 2-3px dots with running lights.

ART DIRECTION — take strong inspiration from the CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS anime aesthetic: hyper-saturated neon against deep shadow, BOLD FLAT ANIME COLOUR BLOCKING rather than soft rendering, enormous holographic advertising panels glowing on building faces, dense grimy megabuilding architecture stacked with add-on modules and hab-units, exposed ducting and cable runs, chunky brutalist concrete masses lit from below by signage, and a general feeling of a city that is overcrowded, over-advertised and alive. Colour should feel electric and excessive, never tasteful or muted.

SIGNATURE MOTIFS — these define the look, include them generously:
1. ENORMOUS ILLUMINATED ADVERTISING PANELS mounted flat on building faces, several storeys tall, showing simple bold FIGURATIVE imagery in silhouette — a stylised face in profile, an eye, a hand, a bottle, a stylised flower — rendered as flat blocks of saturated colour. These giant ads are the single most important element; they should dominate several building faces and be far larger than the small vertical signs. Never readable text, only shapes and figures.
2. ELEVATED TRANSIT INFRASTRUCTURE — a monorail or highway deck on heavy pylons crossing the frame horizontally, with a line of small lights along its underside and cabling slung beneath it.
3. VERTICAL SIGN STACKS — columns of small Japanese-style signboards climbing building corners, each a different saturated colour.
4. BOLTED-ON HAB MODULES and shipping-container units stacked onto older concrete structures, with exposed ducting, ladders and cable runs between them.

COLOUR TEMPERATURE: play WARM against COOL — coral, hot pink, amber and orange signage set against teal, indigo and violet building masses. That warm/cool collision is what makes the city feel alive rather than monochrome.

PERSPECTIVE — CRITICAL: strict FLAT SIDE ELEVATION, as if photographed head-on from directly across the street at the same height. You see ONLY the vertical FACES of buildings. NEVER show the top surface of a roof, NEVER show a roof at an angle, NEVER draw anything in three-quarter or top-down view. No perspective convergence, no vanishing points, no foreshortening. Every rooftop is a simple flat horizontal edge seen edge-on.

TILING EDGES — CRITICAL: the far LEFT and far RIGHT edges of the image must be EMPTY DARK SKY. No building, pole, cable, sign, antenna or structure may touch or cross either edge. Keep a clear empty margin down both sides so this segment can be joined to another without anything being cut off mid-object.

COLOUR — this is CYBERPUNK 2077 NIGHT CITY. The city is LIVELY and saturated. Use hot magenta #FF2D95, electric purple #B026FF, warm orange #FF6B1A and amber #FFD400 for neon signage ALONGSIDE the cyans and greens. Do NOT restrict the city to blue and green — that reads dead. Building masses stay dark so the foreground stays readable, but the SIGNAGE and lit windows should be a riot of colour: pink, purple, orange, amber, cyan, green, red.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels, hard aliased edges, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.

ABSOLUTELY NO TORII GATE anywhere. NO characters, NO readable text, NO labels, NO watermark, NO walkable platforms.

PALETTE — use these: #000000 #0A0E1F #14103A #241A5C #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #00E5FF #8FE8FF #B026FF #FF2D95 #FF6B1A #FFD400 #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568.

The upper portion of the image is PURE BLACK #000000 empty sky with nothing in it — no stars, no colour, no clouds, no haze. The game draws its own sky behind this layer.
